Keywords: Baggage and retreat through rock roads
RagShortTexts: A Caucasian constriction carried animals, food and households as well as fighters.

Variants.Content: A Caucasian constriction carried animals, food and households as well as fighters. Baggage behind an advance might obstruct a retreat. Ordering the column therefore concerned return as well as progress, rather than only the distance a vanguard could cover.
